privacyPolicy.metaDesc: Privacy Policy for Mukti Hospital App — What information we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect it.
privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Mukti Hospital Mobile App
privacyPolicy.leadText: The privacy of your personal and health-related information is extremely important to us. In this policy, we clearly explain what information we collect, why we collect it, how we use and protect it, and your rights regarding it.
privacyPolicy.sec1Desc: While using the Mukti Hospital app, we may collect the following information:
privacyPolicy.sec1AccDesc: Name and mobile number — for account creation and OTP verification.
privacyPolicy.sec1HealthDesc: Gender, date of birth, age, blood group, height, and weight — provided in your profile. Used for appointments and patient records.
privacyPolicy.sec1ApptDesc: Patient's name, mobile number, and selected doctor or service.
privacyPolicy.sec1FamilyDesc1: If you add family members, their name, relationship, age, and gender — this information is stored
privacyPolicy.sec1FamilyDesc3: and is not transmitted to our servers.
privacyPolicy.sec1AutoDesc: Basic technical data required to run the app properly (e.g., app version). We do not collect location tracking or advertising-related data.
privacyPolicy.sec2Point1: To confirm doctor appointments and serials and notify via SMS.
privacyPolicy.sec2Point2: To display your patient records and lab test reports.
privacyPolicy.sec2Point3: To send OTPs for account verification and security.
privacyPolicy.sec2Point4: To make urgent service-related communications from the hospital if needed.
privacyPolicy.sec3Desc2: sell or rent your personal or health information to any third party
privacyPolicy.sec3Desc3: . Information is only shared under the following conditions:
privacyPolicy.sec3Point1: Within Mukti Hospital and authorized medical staff to deliver care.
privacyPolicy.sec3Point2: With SMS gateway providers to send OTPs and notifications (solely for messaging).
privacyPolicy.sec3Point3: When required by applicable legal obligations.
privacyPolicy.sec4Desc: Your account is verified via mobile OTP. Login credentials are safely stored on your device using encrypted storage. However, no internet-based system is 100% secure — we strive to implement the highest reasonable standards of security.
privacyPolicy.sec5Point1: View and update your profile information at any time.
privacyPolicy.sec5Point2: Request account and data deletion via App Settings → Delete Account.
privacyPolicy.sec5Point3: Delete locally stored family member information directly from your device at any time.
privacyPolicy.sec6RetentionDesc: We retain personal and health data (e.g., name, mobile number, appointment history, test reports) on secure servers only for as long as necessary to deliver medical services and meet legal or administrative recordkeeping obligations.
privacyPolicy.sec6DeletionDesc: If a user wishes to permanently delete their account and personal data, they can submit a request via two methods:
privacyPolicy.sec6DelWebDesc: By filling out the form on our dedicated web portal at https://muktihospital.com/app/delete-account/
privacyPolicy.sec6TimeframeDesc: Within a maximum of 7 business days of receiving the request, all personal data and account records will be permanently deleted from our primary databases and servers. Certain records may be retained if required by law or hospital regulation.
privacyPolicy.sec7Desc: The app is intended for adult use. Parents or legal guardians may book appointments on behalf of minors, but the registered account must remain under an adult's name.
privacyPolicy.sec8Desc: We may update this Privacy Policy as needed. Significant changes will be communicated via the app or website. Please refer to the "Last Updated" date above for the current version.
privacyPolicy.sec9Desc: If you have any questions regarding this policy or your personal data, please contact:
privacyPolicy.address: Dhaka–Chittagong Bypass Road, Racecourse, Shashongacha, Cumilla–3500
